verdict.rationale: Dagster orchestrates loading tools such as Airbyte, Fivetran and dlt as assets, which indirectly enables loading data. A Dagster team member describes separating business logic from environmental concerns, which hints at destination portability. However, no evidence names any of the specific warehouses or lakes, or shows destinations being swapped without code changes. Missing for 10: documented native Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks/Postgres/object-storage integrations, evidence of swapping destinations without changing pipeline code (e.g., resource/IO-manager abstraction docs), hands-on corroboration.
